bio.text: Joe Neguse represents Colorado's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and, since March 2024, has served as House Assistant Minority Leader.

Before Congress he was Executive Director of Colorado's consumer protection agency in the Governor's Cabinet and, earlier, an elected member of the University of Colorado Board of Regents for a six-year term.
He received a B.S. in political science and economics from the University of Colorado Boulder and a J.D. from the University of Colorado School of Law.
